lines.text: Hello, come and sit down. What's brought you in today?
I'm coming in with pain on the right side of my lower back.
About three weeks ago, after I'd been digging the allotment all weekend.
Any numbness or tingling down the legs, or trouble going to the toilet?
No, none of that, no tingling at all and going to the toilet is fine.
Bend forward for me as far as is comfortable. Right, you're stopping about mid shin, and the muscles beside the spine on the right are guarding.
Keep walking every day, little and often, and avoid sitting for longer than half an hour at a stretch.
If you lose feeling in your saddle area or can't control your bladder, ring 111 or go to A and E straight away.
Lovely, book in for a week's time at the desk. Take care now.
Right then, come on through. Hiya, I'm Dan, have a seat.
Hiya. I've had this clicking in my jaw for about two months now.
